1. A farmer weighs a sack of potatoes and finds it to be 10 kg 500 g. If the farmer has 4 such potato sacks, what is the total weight of all the sacks? 4 × 10 kg 500 g = 4 ×10 kg and 4 × 500 g = 40 kg + 2000 g = 40 kg + 2 kg = 42 kg. 4 kg ÷ 4 = 1 kg 800 g ÷ 4 = 200 g So, 4 kg 800 g ÷ 4 = 1 kg 200 g You can find the product by multiplying the kg and g separately and adding the two.
